meta.title: Savanna Animals Song for Kids! Meet 5 Zoo Friends with Milo
meta.description:
Sing the Savanna Animals Song with Milo the blue bird! Meet a lion, an elephant, a giraffe, a zebra and a hippo in this 3D animal song for kids.
Kids learn savanna animal names, their sounds, and one true fact about each animal. Great for toddlers and preschoolers, ages 2-6.

What kids learn:
- Lions live in family groups called prides
- Elephants use their trunks to smell and to drink
- Giraffes are the tallest animals in the world
- Every zebra's stripes are different
- Hippos stay in the water to keep cool on hot days

Sing along, roar like a lion, stomp like an elephant and stretch like a giraffe!
